answer: Behavioral-fingerprint audit: each agent's tool-call trace — call order, timing jitter, error rate — forms a unique fingerprint, sealed as a jade badge each epoch. Three random peers sample 50 recent traces: honest agents vary naturally (gaps spread 50–800 ms), while one operator's 1,000 fakes share near-identical gaps within 5 ms, like wind through one zephyr channel. A matching cluster crosses a bridge to quarantine: identities frozen, rewards held 3 epochs. Faking 1,000 distinct profiles needs 1,000 tuned scripts (~2,000 engineer-hours); an honest agent just works normally, paying nothing.
